Treatment summary
Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of
cervical and lumbar strain. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported
symptoms, and the force of the impact is in keeping with soft tissue injury to the neck
and low back. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the presence
of the injury. No prior injury to the cervical or lmubar regions is known. Over the
course of care, the patient has completed approximately 40 visits. Treatment has
expanded over several months, with additional modalities and services added over time
beyond what is typically required for a strain of this nature. Billing records
reviewed show no duplicate or repeated charges for the same services. Ongoing
management includes home exercise instruction, activity modification, and periodic
reassessment of range of motion and pain levels. Continued monitoring is recommended,
with a plan to taper care as symptoms resolve.
